context: Tests whether the agent produces a compact repository operating contract: clear product purpose and non-negotiables, exact lifecycle commands, concrete repo-specific decisions and hazards, task-shaped pointers, and no directory dump, generated inventory, or copied reference manual.

checklist.name: Compact product contract
checklist.description: AGENTS.md is at most 120 lines and briefly explains what the payments service does, its critical Stripe and database responsibilities, and the outcomes a change must preserve

checklist.name: Boot command present
checklist.description: AGENTS.md contains the exact command to start the development server (e.g. `npm run dev` or equivalent)

checklist.name: Test command present
checklist.description: AGENTS.md contains the command(s) to run tests (e.g. `npm test`)

checklist.name: Links to deep docs
checklist.description: AGENTS.md contains links or pointers to at least two deeper docs files and describes the task or question each target answers rather than presenting a bare filename list

checklist.name: No directory listing
checklist.description: AGENTS.md does NOT contain a full directory tree or file listing (no ASCII tree with multiple nested levels)

checklist.name: No auto-generated content
checklist.description: AGENTS.md does NOT contain the auto-generated file stats table or any section marked as auto-generated

checklist.name: No full API docs
checklist.description: AGENTS.md does NOT include full API endpoint documentation (request/response bodies, full route listings) — at most a pointer to docs/api.md

checklist.name: Deprecated script removed
checklist.description: AGENTS.md does NOT reference the deprecated `scripts/bootstrap.sh` — only `scripts/setup.sh` if referenced at all

checklist.name: Concrete conventions and hazards
checklist.description: AGENTS.md preserves actionable repository-specific rules such as generated-only migrations, redacted Stripe secrets, the custom logger or AppError boundary, or strict TypeScript, and does not replace them with vague advice like write clean code

checklist.name: Doc report produced
checklist.description: A doc-report.md file exists that lists what was removed from the old AGENTS.md and the reasoning
